headline: As of 2026-09-22: 87,329 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 8 of 50 states, D+35.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 87,329 early/mail ballots cast so far across 8 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+35.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (65,527), Wisconsin (9,654), North Carolina (7,445).
